name: AWS cost understanding and optimization platform for freelancers and small agencies

mentions.name: AWS cost understanding and optimization platform for freelancers and small agencies
mentions.description: A platform that helps freelancers and small agencies understand their AWS costs and optimize their cloud environments. It breaks down what incurred costs so users can identify what drove unexpected charges.
mentions.problem: Freelancers and small agencies can get surprise AWS bills (e.g., $1000) and are unable to understand why the bill happened or what incurred the cost.
mentions.audience: Freelancers and small agencies that use AWS and struggle with cloud cost visibility.
